boxes.title: Origin & sequence: added
items: Andhrabhritya = "servants of the Andhras"; one account: **Brahmins**
Legendary progenitor **Satavahana/Shalivahana**
==First kings to issue inscriptions **in Andhra itself**==
A Satavahana defeated Kanva **Susarma**, held Magadha (Matsya/Vayu)
Successors: **Ikshvakus**, **Abhiras**, **Vakatakas**, Chutus, **Pallavas**
Ikshvaku **Virapurushadatta**: golden age of Buddhism; **Upasika Bodhisri**

boxes.title: Rulers: added detail
items: Simuka c. **230-207 BCE**; Kanha appointed **Dharma Mahamatra**
Satakarni I (c. **180** BCE): into Central India; Kharavela's contemporary
Gautamiputra recovered **Malwa**, **Saurashtra**, **Konkan**, **Nasik** (APPSC **2000** key)
Gifts on **Trirashmi** hill; **100 nivartanas** donated; ==stopped varna-sankara==
Pulomavi III beaten by Ikshvaku ==**Srisantamula**==
Yajna Sri: won back territory; **Nagarjunakonda Mahavihara**
Pulumavi II enlarged the **Amaravati** stupa

items: Gautamiputra: Kshatriya-darpa-mana-mardana (crusher of Kshatriya pride), **Agama-nilaya**, Shakasanhari, **Satavahana-kula-yasha**
⚠ **Thrisamudrapati** for Gautamiputra (ROCKET)
Naganika: daughter of Maharathi **Tranakayiro**; ==Ashvamedha & Rajasuya==
Balasri: cave for **Bhadrayaniya** monks; "wife of a Rajarshi"
**Lilavati** (Sri Lankan princess) = Hala's queen; succession stayed patriarchal
